name: Deel
tagline: Deel handles payroll, contracts, and tax compliance for companies paying employees and contractors across different countries. Its AI reviews contracts against local labor law and currency rules before payment, which matters for payroll specialists managing a workforce spread across jurisdictions they do not each have a specialist for.
